title: Social, Private, or Membership?
why: Warm leads deciding how to book: lay out the three options with real prices and a real guest quote for each, then a one-line pick.
hook_options: Social, private, or membership? Pick in a minute.
Solo, celebrating, or hooked? Here's your session.
caption: Three ways onto the same floating sauna. Social: share with up to 8, from $49 off-peak. Private: the whole thing for up to 10, from $449 off-peak. slides.body: Same sauna, same river. The difference is who's on the deck and how often you come back.

slides.headline: Social session
slides.body: Share the sauna and deck with up to 8 guests. $49 off-peak, $59 peak, per person. 1 hour 45 minutes.

slides.headline: "Sharing the sauna with strangers was actually very fun."
slides.body: A. P., first-timer, Google review. Pick social if you're solo, a pair, or just curious.

slides.headline: Private session
slides.body: The whole floating sauna, your group only, up to 10 people. $449 off-peak, $539 peak.

slides.headline: "We celebrated two birthdays with a group of 10."
slides.body: Ginny T., Google review. Pick private for birthdays, offsites, or a family that wants the deck to itself.

slides.headline: Membership
slides.body: From $99 a month. No minimum commitment, cancel anytime. Members can bring a friend at the member rate.

slides.headline: "I've been back three times already."
slides.body: Jacqueline S., Google review. Pick membership when one session turns into a habit.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Ebb and Ember/Assets/Ebb and Ember Photos & Videos/IMG_8828.JPG

slides.headline: Plans change. Your money doesn't vanish.
slides.body: Cancellations become a gift card for a future session. All sales are final, so it's credit, not a refund.

slides.headline: Curious? Social. Celebrating? Private. Hooked? Member.
slides.body: Not sure? Start social. You can always book a private next time.

slides.headline: Pick your session.
slides.body: Portland's floating sauna on the Columbia River. Book at ebbandember.com.
